note: Editor clip samples on the actual prefab and catalogue (cut poses, actors at the same root) and native-envelope slides (FootballDuelTiming, both leads, entry, hold and recovery at 60 Hz). Bit-identity of the candidate to the release actor is required. The drawn low-poly surface is judged against the release reference in the same pose (paired visible surface: drawn skin against the ground skin (release mesh, same bones and pose). Absolute (strict) where an existing limit holds for the drawn release surface: boot lowest -0.01 m locomotion / -0.035 m slide (Duel) / -0.02 m otherwise, body lowest (gloves included) -0.01 m locomotion / -0.02 m where gated; outside a limit only an equally failing release reference with a candidate excess <= 1e-4 m is inherited. Paired where the drawn release surface itself misses the limit: boot and glove surface on the ball (|gap| limit 0.03 m reported), boots and body in keeper saves, body in slides: candidate at most 0.01 m worse than the release reference, absolute crossings reported. Shape (additional QA bound, not an existing controller gate): boot lowest points, the foot ball gap and each glove ball gap (per hand, against the same hand) also differ at most 0.01 m from the release reference in either direction (signed shift candidate - release)). Not a GPU, device or WebGL measurement.

sentinelFloat.note: paired visible surface: drawn skin against the ground skin (release mesh, same bones and pose). Absolute (strict) where an existing limit holds for the drawn release surface: boot lowest -0.01 m locomotion / -0.035 m slide (Duel) / -0.02 m otherwise, body lowest (gloves included) -0.01 m locomotion / -0.02 m where gated; outside a limit only an equally failing release reference with a candidate excess <= 1e-4 m is inherited. Paired where the drawn release surface itself misses the limit: boot and glove surface on the ball (|gap| limit 0.03 m reported), boots and body in keeper saves, body in slides: candidate at most 0.01 m worse than the release reference, absolute crossings reported. Shape (additional QA bound, not an existing controller gate): boot lowest points, the foot ball gap and each glove ball gap (per hand, against the same hand) also differ at most 0.01 m from the release reference in either direction (signed shift candidate - release)
